# 2 Baruch Chapter 29 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 2 Baruch Chapter 29 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 29:2 — "treasury of manna / heavenly storehouse of manna"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-treasure-of-manna" | Literal: Syriac sima d-manna |
| LOGOS | "the treasury of manna" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "the heavenly storehouse of manna" | Adds "heavenly" and substitutes "storehouse" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained "the treasury of manna" (LOGOS). The term treasury (sima) links to the treasury of souls motif in chs. 23-24 and should be translated consistently.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Terminological consistency.

---

## 29:4 — "will be revealed / will emerge / will be released"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Behemoth will-be-revealed from-his-place" | Literal: Syriac ethgele = be revealed |
| LOGOS | "Behemoth will be revealed from his place" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "Behemoth will emerge from his hiding place" | Interprets "his place" as a hiding place |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Retained LOGOS "will be revealed from his place." "Revealed" is the precise Syriac term — Behemoth's manifestation is an apocalyptic uncovering, not just emergence. PNEUMA's "hiding place" adds a concept not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 29:5 — "ten-thousandfold / ten thousand fold"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "ten-thousand-fold" | Hyphenated per EMET convention |
| LOGOS | "ten-thousandfold" | Standard compound |
| PNEUMA | "a ten-thousandfold" | With article |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "ten-thousandfold." Standard English compound. Minor variation only.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Orthographic preference.

---

## 29:7 — "aromatic fruits / sweet-smelling fruits / spiced fruits"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-fragrance-of-aromatic-fruits" | Literal compound |
| LOGOS | "the fragrance of aromatic fruits" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "the scent of sweet-smelling fruits" | Near synonym pair |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "fragrance of aromatic fruits." "Aromatic" is the more precise term; "fragrance" over PNEUMA's "scent" for register.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS. Minor lexical preference.

---
